checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals paid-campaign-build, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals paid-campaign-build; description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: The entire structure is built paused and never spends or goes live on its own.
checks.rule: Steps and hard rules state everything is built paused and the build never spends or flips live.

checks.description: staged_structure covers campaign, ad sets, ads, targeting, placements, budget, and schedule.
checks.rule: Output staged_structure includes campaign, ad sets, ads, targeting, placements, budget, and schedule.

checks.description: Each ad set maps to one creative variant and one copy variant by id.
checks.rule: Steps and template bind every ad set to a creative variant id and a copy variant id.

checks.description: Budget, bid, target, schedule, and geo all trace to the brief; missing means stop and ask.
checks.rule: Hard rules require every budget, bid, target, schedule, and geo to trace to the brief and forbid assumption.

checks.description: A pre-launch checklist covers pixel firing, UTMs, naming, budget cap, and end date and gates the package.
checks.rule: Output includes a checklist covering pixel firing, UTMs, naming, budget cap, end date; a failing check blocks the gate.

checks.description: The pre-launch checklist also verifies a live test event in Events Manager, the conversion event and its location, audience geo and demographics, bid strategy and amount, creative spell-check, video captions, and for search negative keywords, match types, and ad assets.
checks.rule: Checklist additionally covers a live test event in Events Manager, conversion event and conversion location, audience geo and demographics, bid strategy and bid amount, creative spell-check, video captions, and search-only negative keywords, match types, and ad assets or extensions; each is pass/fail and a failing check blocks the gate.

checks.description: No personal or sensitive data in URL parameters or tracking; no accreditation implication.
checks.rule: Hard rules forbid personal or sensitive data in URL parameters and forbid accreditation implication.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file and in-platform copy.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash glyph, no tatweel (U+0640), and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).

checks.description: Output populates the staged_structure and checklist fields of the paid-launch-package.
checks.rule: Output is described as the staged_structure and checklist fields of the paid-launch-package per handoff-contract.md.
